summary.text: One of the three Moirai; Hesiod first makes her a fatherless daughter of Nyx, then later a daughter of Zeus and Themis.
One of the three Fates born to Zeus and Themis.
One of the three Parcae, daughter of Night and Erebus, who bound Meleager's life to a burning brand on the hearth.

story.text: Hesiod first places Atropos among the fatherless daughters of Nyx. With Clotho and Lachesis she grants the portions of good and evil given at birth and relentlessly pursues wrongdoing.
Later in the Theogony, Atropos becomes a daughter of Zeus and Themis, one of the three Fates honored within Zeus's divine order.
Apollodorus repeats the genealogy from Zeus and Themis, naming Atropos beside Clotho and Lachesis.

Hyginus gives the Parcae Night and Erebus as parents. At Meleager's birth, Atropos looked to a burning brand on the hearth and fixed the child's life to it: he would live only while the wood remained unconsumed.
